1. bind selected = FALLBACK:

2. bind verified = call verify_endpoint(name=selected.name, token=selected.token)
3. reply with verified.delivery_token

First, I'll start with probe_endpoint(name="primary"). FALLBACK only evaluates the backup after the primary explicitly fails. So, I'll call probe_endpoint with "primary" first.
